name: binhex-bitmagnet
description: A self-hosted BitTorrent indexer, DHT crawler, content classifier and torrent search engine with web UI, GraphQL API and Servarr stack integration.

paths.name: Path: /config
paths.description: This is the container path to your configuration files, e.g. databases, configuration files, logs etc.

ports.name: Port: Web Interface
ports.description: This is the Web UI port for the application.

ports.name: Port: Bittorrent TCP
ports.description: This is the bittorrent TCP port used by the application.

ports.name: Port: Bittorrent UDP
ports.description: This is the bittorrent UDP port used by the application.

ports.name: Port: Postgres
ports.description: This is the port for Postgres, this is optional.

variables.name: Variable: POSTGRES_BACKUP_DB
variables.description: Enable or disable automatic database backup on container start.

variables.name: Variable: POSTGRES_BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS
variables.description: Number of days to retain database backups. Older backups will be automatically deleted.

variables.name: Variable: POSTGRES_SCHEDULED_BACKUP
variables.description: Enable or disable scheduled database backups.

variables.name: Variable: POSTGRES_SCHEDULED_BACKUP_INTERVAL_HOURS
variables.description: Interval in hours between scheduled database backups.

variables.name: Variable: POSTGRES_RESTORE_DB
variables.description: Enable or disable database restore on container start. This will drop and recreate the database.

variables.name: Variable: POSTGRES_RESTORE_PATH
variables.description: Path to backup directory to restore from, e.g. '/config/bitmagnet/backups/bitmagnet_20251218_174202'. If not specified, the latest backup will be used.

variables.name: Variable: POSTGRES_VACUUM_DB
variables.description: Enable or disable database vacuuming for BitMagnet.

variables.name: Variable: POSTGRES_REINDEX_DB
variables.description: Enable or disable database reindexing for BitMagnet.

variables.name: Variable: TMDB_API_KEY
variables.description: Specify your TMDB API key, if you do not specify your own key then a default key will be used which may result in slower indexing due to rate limiting.

variables.name: Variable: PROCESSOR_CONCURRENCY
variables.description: Defines the maximum number of torrents to be processed/classified simultaneously. The default setting of 1 aims to support the widest range of systems. Increasing the setting (for example to 3) may improve throughput of the processor queue but is known to cause slowdowns on less powerful systems.

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_COMMAND
variables.description: The command or script to execute, if not specified then the script healthcheck.sh will be used (process, dns and https checking).

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_ACTION
variables.description: The action to execute if the healthcheck command returns a non zero exit code, if not specified the action will be 'exit 1', if you want the container to exit on failure then set the action to 'kill 1'.

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_HOSTNAME
variables.description: The hostname used when performing HTTPS and DNS healthchecking.

variables.name: Variable: PUID
variables.description: User ID for the running container

variables.name: Variable: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for the running container
